items.title: Launch HN: RonanRX (YC S26) – Personalized Peptides and GLP-1s
items.summary: Hi HN, I’m Lloyd, one of two founders of RonanRx ( https://ronanrx.com/ ). We are building a vertically integrated pharmaceutical company with software for prescribing, telehealth, compounding, manufacturing, and delivery. We are starting with GLP-1s and peptides. The path to RonanRx is fairly unconventional. During the pandemic, I built one of the largest mask manufacturing factories in the US. We could make a million masks in a day. We converted raw polypropylene pellets into finished pallets of masks. I had a background in software from my YC W10 company, so we took a software approach to building our factory. We used machine learning and computer vision to optimize production. We also vertically integrated almost everything. It worked. We built an efficient manufacturing operation and grew the business to 50 million dollars in revenue. Then people actually stopped caring about masks. Fair enough. Around the same time, I decided to try and lose the weight I had gained while building the factory. I ate nothing but chicken for six months. While this diet got some results, I plateaued. My doctor suggested tirzepatide, a GLP-1 medication. For me, losing weight was only the beginning. "Food noise" was gone. I showed less interest in other compulsive behavior. I stopped scrolling Instagram and quit biting my nails. But that was just the beginning. I was born with a congenital heart defect called aortic stenosis. My whole life doctors told me I'd need open heart surgery in my…

items.title: GLP-1 for Severe Obesity, PCOS and Binge Eating Disorder (with Rachael Gullette)
items.summary: 🎈FREE Masterclass: How To MICRODOSE GLP-1 HOLISTICALLY Release 20 lbs in 12 Weeks 👉 https://go.elizabethmcgann.com/masterclass (Without the Side Effects, Muscle Loss, or Being on Medication for Life) If you’ve been hearing about GLP-1 medications and wondering whether they might help you… But you also feel nervous, skeptical, or unsure… then this is the perfect episode for you. Here’s what most people aren’t learning about online: Weight loss struggles exist on a spectrum. For some women (especially after 40), improving nutrition, gut health, and blood sugar can completely change their health. Some might not need a GLP-1 at all… or may only need a microdose for additional support. But for others…the problem runs much deeper. Today’s guest, Rachael Gullette, is a GLP-1 advocate and content creator who has lost more than 160 POUNDS. She lived on the far end of the spectrum and has spent her life navigating severe obesity, PCOS, ADHD, binge eating disorder, and deep metabolic dysfunction. Her brain was wired for constant dopamine-seeking, and food became the coping mechanism. When she started a GLP-1 medication… everything changed. *In this episode, you’ll learn:* • what “food noise” actually feels like • why some women can lose weight naturally and others can’t • how GLP-1 impacts brain chemistry, metabolism, and behavior • and how to start understanding where you fall on the spectrum This episode is about helping you understand your body and choosing the level of support…
